name: Koishikawa Hana
source: A first year student at Onosaki High School. She's the female manager of the baseball club. She doesn't know much about baseball, but her adorable looks and all-out efforts won over the club members, making her an indispensable part of the club. At first she intrepidly works hard to support them, but...
